Internal helper: a style file saved with .txt after its name

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_style_txt_twin.Rd

A style that comes back from an AI assistant, or out of a text editor, is often saved as name.jstyle.txt or name.txt, which no lookup reads: .jstyle is the one extension (ruling R81, Session 419). The folders a style name is looked for in are read for such a file, so the stop for a name not found can name it and give the line that renames it. name.jstyle.txt counts whatever it holds; name.txt only when its text reads as a style file (.jst_style_text_like()), since a folder may hold a notes file of any name. A built-in's name never comes here: the built-in is loaded before any file is looked for, and a built-in's name typed with .txt gets the did-you-mean first.

Usage

.jst_style_txt_twin(stem)

Arguments

stem

Character(1); the style's name, without .jstyle or .txt.

Value

NULL, or a list: from (the file found), to (the name it needs) and where (the folder's role, opening a sentence).
